snippet.title: Amiga Longplay [812] RollerBall [MIRROR]
snippet.description:
Original name: Amiga Longplay [812] RollerBall
A longplay by HIPOONIOS.
It was originally hosted by RecordedAmigaGames AKA World of Longplays. It was brought up again at one point only to disappear again.

The uploaded copy is 360p, so do not expect the usual Longplay standard of no compression artifacts. This is the best version of the video I have an access to.

I cannot find this video anywhere on the longplays dot org site or even archive dot org. In the case the case the original creator cannot for some reason claim ownership of the video (for example, for being a part of a witness protection program - a guess in jest), I'll nominally claim the ownership of the gameplay video strictly for the purposes of showing it for non-profit educative and informative purposes.

The game Rollerball (1994) is a clone of Jump 'N' Roll, a clone of Trailblazer (1986). It has probably the best soundtrack by the composer Jimmy Fredriksson. Apparently it was a commercial release despite the timing and the shortness of the game. It was allegedly programmed by Harald Müller (Mueller).
